facts.fact: Usha knows from the queen's household that a ledger page burned of itself at the Resin House on the new-moon night (Neela's self-naming), and asks what the naming cost; she does not name the shape. Neela tells her publicly only the wound-share.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Usha ask what the naming cost; the Chathu post reaching the household makes it plausible.

facts.fact: Devan carries the oilcloth bundle (hide contract chit and the queen's payment writ, tied with red thread) in his pack on the hill, not in the shutter frame at Kettamala.
facts.why: needed because the beat has him check it in his pack.

facts.fact: Usha says the pass-village watcher's scent log goes to a cell at Kettamala and on to whoever opens the prisoner's post, which is the queen's household. This matches F666 and F713.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Usha explain how she found the shelter.

facts.fact: Devan orders 'Nobody smears tonight' so no stranger can witness a turning; the Company obeys without asking why.
facts.why: needed to keep Usha from becoming a witness at dusk, per the chapter goal.

facts.fact: Usha is First Guard's given name, offered unasked; the letter calls the forty 'those who came down from the Resin House'.
facts.why: beat requires the name and the letter's address.

facts.fact: Devan's 'Tuesday' nick while shaving: Neela finds the welt on her chin over her rice. Neela mentions it to Usha as a joke.
facts.why: illustrates the wound-share in dialogue; a minor texture detail.
